### TCGA-BRCA

### convert raw counts to TPM

```{r}
if (!require("biomaRt")) 
  BiocManager::install("biomaRt")
```

```{r}
library(biomaRt)
```

```{r}
library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)

mart <- useMart(
  "ensembl",
  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
  host = "https://useast.ensembl.org"
)

gene_lengths <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "start_position", "end_position"),
  mart = mart
)

gene_lengths$length_kb <- (
  gene_lengths$end_position - gene_lengths$start_position
) / 1000

gene_lengths <- gene_lengths %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
counts_matrix <- read.csv("counts_with_genes_symbol.csv")
basal <- read.csv("counts_basal.csv")
```

```{r}
head(counts_matrix,5)
```

```{r}
cat("Rows:", nrow(basel), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(basel), "\n")

cat("Gene names:", length(unlist(basel[1, -1])), "\n")
cat("Sample names:", length(unlist(basel[-1, 1])), "\n")
```

```{r}
# 1. Gene names = column names of original, excluding sample barcode
gene_names <- colnames(basel)[-1]

# 2. Sample names = first column of original
sample_names <- basel[[1]]

# 3. Expression data = everything except first column
counts <- basel[, -1]

# 4. Convert expression values to numeric
counts <- as.matrix(
  data.frame(
    lapply(counts, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
)

# 5. Transpose: genes × samples
tcga_counts_basal <- t(counts)

# 6. Assign names
rownames(tcga_counts_basal) <- gene_names
colnames(tcga_counts_basal) <- sample_names

# Check
dim(tcga_counts_basal)
head(rownames(tcga_counts_basal))
head(colnames(tcga_counts_basal))
```

```{r}
rownames(tcga_counts_basal) <- gene_names
colnames(tcga_counts_basal) <- sample_names

counts_to_tpm <- function(counts_matrix, gene_lengths_df) {
  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(counts_matrix), gene_lengths_df$hgnc_symbol)
  counts_sub <- counts_matrix[common_genes, ]
  lengths_sub <- gene_lengths_df$length_kb[match(common_genes, gene_lengths_df$hgnc_symbol)]
  
  rpk <- counts_sub / lengths_sub          # reads per kilobase
  scaling_factors <- colSums(rpk) / 1e6    # per-million scaling factor
  tpm <- sweep(rpk, 2, scaling_factors, "/")
  return(tpm)
}

# tcga_counts_basal should be your raw-count matrix, genes x samples,
# restricted to Basal-like samples, gene symbols as rownames
tcga_tpm_basal <- counts_to_tpm(tcga_counts_basal, gene_lengths)
```

```{r}
dim(tcga_tpm_basal)

head(rownames(tcga_tpm_basal))

colSums(tcga_tpm_basal)[1:5]

summary(as.vector(tcga_tpm_basal))
```

Run quanTIseq on TCGA-BRCA

```{r}
tcga_quantiseq <- deconvolute(tcga_tpm_basal, method = "quantiseq")
print(tcga_quantiseq)
```

```{r}
# Save gene identifiers
gene_names <- scanb_expr_basal$V1

# Remove the gene-name column
scanb_expr_basal <- scanb_expr_basal[, -1]

rownames(scanb_expr_basal) <- gene_names
```

```{r}
scanb_linear_basal <- 2^scanb_expr_basal - 1  # reverse log2(x+1)-style transform
# (adjust the "-1" if your original transform used a different pseudocount)

scanb_quantiseq <- deconvolute(scanb_linear_basal, method = "quantiseq")
print(scanb_quantiseq)
```

```{r}
tcga_quantiseq$cohort <- "TCGA"
quantiseq_result$cohort <- "METABRIC"
scanb_quantiseq$cohort <- "SCAN-B"

all_quantiseq <- bind_rows(tcga_quantiseq, quantiseq_result, scanb_quantiseq)

library(tidyr)
long_format <- all_quantiseq %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(cell_type, cohort), names_to = "sample", values_to = "fraction")
```

```{r}
# Boxplot comparing each immune cell type's proportion across cohorts
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(long_format, aes(x = cell_type, y = fraction, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Immune cell type composition: Basal-like tumors across cohorts",
       y = "Estimated fraction", x = "Cell type")
ggsave("immune_composition_comparison.png", width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 150)
```

```{r}
# Statistical test: does each cell type's proportion differ significantly
# across the three cohorts?
cell_types <- unique(long_format$cell_type)
kw_results <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  sub <- long_format %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  test <- kruskal.test(fraction ~ cohort, data = sub)
  data.frame(cell_type = ct, kw_stat = test$statistic, pvalue = test$p.value)
})
kw_results_df <- bind_rows(kw_results)
kw_results_df$padj <- p.adjust(kw_results_df$pvalue, method = "BH")
print(kw_results_df[order(kw_results_df$padj), ])

write.csv(kw_results_df, "immune_composition_cohort_differences.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Specific immune cell in TCGA

```{r}
fao_score <- read.csv("fao_score.csv")
```

```{r}
fao_score <- setNames(
  fao_score$Fatty.acid.oxidation,
  fao_score$X
)
```

```{r}
common_samples <- intersect(
  colnames(tcga_quantiseq)[-1],
  names(fao_score)
)

length(common_samples)
```

```{r}
ct <- tcga_quantiseq$cell_type[1]

ct_data <- tcga_quantiseq %>%
  filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
  dplyr::select(-cell_type)

ct_values <- as.numeric(ct_data[1, ])
names(ct_values) <- colnames(ct_data)

ct_values <- ct_values[common_samples]
fao_values <- fao_score[common_samples]

cor.test(ct_values, fao_values, method = "spearman")
```

```{r}
results <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  
  ct_data <- tcga_quantiseq %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    dplyr::select(-cell_type)
  
  ct_values <- as.numeric(ct_data[1, ])
  names(ct_values) <- colnames(ct_data)
  
  ct_values <- ct_values[common_samples]
  fao_values <- fao_score[common_samples]
  
  test <- cor.test(
    ct_values,
    fao_values,
    method = "spearman"
  )
  
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    rho = unname(test$estimate),
    pvalue = test$p.value
  )
})

results_df <- bind_rows(results)

results_df$padj <- p.adjust(
  results_df$pvalue,
  method = "BH"
)

results_df <- results_df[order(results_df$padj), ]

print(results_df)
```

Fatty Acid Oxidation score correlates specifically with Macrophage M2 infiltration (rho=0.24, padj=0.0066) and CD8+ T cell infiltration (rho=0.19, padj=0.048) in Basal-like breast tumors, while showing no relationship with 8 other immune cell types. This cell-type specificity — consistent with established links between FAO metabolism and M2 macrophage polarization — likely explains why blended immune signatures (like ICR) produced inconsistent correlations with FAO across independent cohorts: a real, cell-type-specific signal gets diluted when averaged across immunologically heterogeneous cell populations.
